v: Why does a Calgary park fill with white crosses every November?
It started in Menlo, Georgia. Calgary businessman Murray McCann saw roadside crosses honouring the town's fallen.
Back home, he shared the idea with the Calgary Poppy Fund. In two thousand nine, a few hundred crosses went up on Memorial Drive.
This year, there are more than three thousand seven hundred. Together, they honour thousands of southern Albertans who died defending Canada.
